PArA PIN
Sign in

Encrypted team chat, calls, and HR, one app, one PIN.

PArA PIN is a private workspace for your team: end-to-end encrypted messaging, video meetings with AI summaries, and the HR tools to run a whole company on. No phone number required, just a 7-digit PIN.

Get started
Already have an account? Sign in

Everything a real workspace needs

Not a chat app with extras bolted on: messaging, meetings, and HR share the same account, the same admin console, and the same security model.
🔒

End-to-end encrypted

Chat messages are encrypted on-device. The server relays ciphertext only, never plaintext, never a backdoor.

🎥

Meetings & calls

1:1 and group video calls, with optional AI transcripts, summaries, and action items after each meeting.

🏢

Workspaces & HR

Org chart, leave requests, public holidays, compensation fields, and CSV bulk import for onboarding a whole roster at once.

🛡️

Enterprise security

TOTP and passkey MFA, device trust with remote logout, new-location alerts, and Generic OIDC single sign-on.

📊

Admin analytics

Usage and call analytics, a full audit log, granular per-role permissions, and retention/legal-hold controls.

🔌

API & webhooks

A REST API and signed webhooks for roster and analytics data, so PArA plugs into whatever you already run.

Built for how a team actually works

Members

Tap the logo to change it. Rename, then Save.
Save
Anyone with a matching company email can request a sign-in link and join automatically, no invite needed. Leave blank to only let existing verified members' emails work.
Used to populate the public holidays calendar in People & HR.
Add
Point each domain at PArA (add it as a Custom Domain on the Worker in your Cloudflare dashboard first), and the sign-in screen there shows this workspace's name and logo before anyone signs in. The domain-hosting step itself has to be done in Cloudflare, not here. You can add more than one.
App-lock timeout — the longest anyone with access to this workspace's data may go without re-authenticating (Face ID/Touch ID/fingerprint/PIN). Applies on top of each person's own device setting; whichever is stricter wins. This is a client-enforced UX control, not a substitute for server-side permissions — it doesn't change who can access what, only how often the app re-locks.
Save security policy
Profile photo protection. Android can technically block screenshots of the full-screen photo viewer (FLAG_SECURE); iOS has no equivalent API — no app can prevent a screenshot there, so this only ever protects Android devices. On iOS the app can detect that a screenshot happened while the viewer was open and report it, but not stop it.
Save photo policy
Single sign-on (OpenID Connect): works with Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or any OIDC-compliant identity provider. Shows a "Sign in with SSO" button on this workspace's custom login domain above.
Save SSO settings
SAML 2.0: for identity providers that don't speak OIDC (older Azure AD/ADFS setups in particular). Shows a "Sign in with SAML SSO" button on this workspace's custom login domain above. Give your IdP the metadata URL:

Overview

Message retention

Applies to every chat. Messages and their attachments older than this get permanently deleted, checked once a day.

Legal hold

Exempts everything a specific person is part of from the retention window above, permanently, until you release the hold. Doesn't grant anyone here the ability to read encrypted chat content, it only stops it from being auto-deleted.
Place on legal hold

Team roster (HR-linked onboarding)

This is the onboarding flow: pre-add someone by name here and hand them the PIN yourself, or add an email to have it sent automatically. Whoever uses it will be asked to choose their own PIN the first time they sign in.
Generate PIN
Bulk import from CSV. Columns: name, department, email (header row optional, email column optional).
Choose CSV file
Download template

Devices & admins

Everyone's PIN locks to whichever devices they've trusted (they add more by approving them from an existing device, see their profile). If someone loses every device at once, reset them here so the next login starts fresh. "Admin" here means access to this console (roster, retention, devices), it's separate from creating a group, which doesn't give anyone special powers over that group.

API keys

Server-to-server access for integrations: roster read/write and the analytics summary only, never chat content (messages stay end-to-end encrypted and this API has no way to read or send them).
Create key

Webhooks

POSTs a signed JSON payload when roster events happen. Verify X-ParaPin-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, hex) with the secret shown below before trusting a delivery.
Add webhook

Public status page

What everyone sees at /status.html — platform-wide, not per-workspace. Set each component's current state, and post incidents as they happen (each update you add is timestamped and kept, never overwritten).

Privacy

Off means both directions, you'll stop sending read confirmations, and you'll stop seeing other people's.
Lets you share your current location in a chat, linked to Google Maps. Off hides that option everywhere.
Mesh (offline device-to-device messaging) not available
This would need a native app with direct Bluetooth/WiFi-Direct radio access, a web app fundamentally can't relay messages phone-to-phone without internet, so this isn't something we can turn on here.
Who can view your full-size profile photo. This controls the full-screen viewer specifically — small thumbnails in chat rows and member lists you're already sharing into a chat aren't covered by this setting.

AI

Off by default. When on, the last few messages in a chat are sent to Cloudflare's AI to suggest quick replies. Those chats normally never leave your device unencrypted, so only turn this on for chats where that trade-off is fine with you.
